name: Super Video Golf
detailed_description:
Super Video Golf is a 90s styled turn-based golf game, with 8 player local and network support. Super Video Golf features a variety of full sized courses, pitch 'n' putt courses and mini golf - each of which can be played in a variety of weather conditions, day or night!

Work your way through 6 challenging leagues and 2 tournaments, Single Player, in Career mode, or in Free Play mode relax with a solo game or any combination of human and CPU players, locally or online.

There is also a tutorial and a driving range for offline practice, with full online leaderboards for both the courses (in Free Play mode) and the driving range. Reaching specific milestones in Career Mode and Free Play will unlock features such as the clubhouse or the course editor which allows arranging any of the available holes into a custom course, as well as new items such as clubs, balls, headwear and player avatars.

In Free Play game modes include:

  • Stroke Play

  • Stableford

  • Stableford Pro

  • Match Play

  • Skins

  • Multi-target

  • Elimination

  • Nearest the Pin

  • Nearest the Pin+

  • Clubset Shuffle

Free Play modes such as Stroke Play and Stableford can also be played as Teams, where both human and CPU players can pair up to compete with a single ball.

The Career mode leagues span 6 seasons across 12 courses, over 36 games. Ranking in the top 3 of each season unlocks new cosmetic items such as balls, headwear and new avatars, which can be used in both Career and Free Play mode.  Two knock-out tournaments add to the challenge via a series of 1v1 rounds, with trophies, unlockable cosmetics and achievements at stake!

When playing Free Play mode Super Video Golf can be played either as couch co-op with up to 8 players using 1-4 compatible controllers or the PC keyboard, or online with up to 8 computers connecting to a single game. Super Video Golf can also be played as a combination of both allowing up to 16 players in a single round.  

With variable difficulty everybody's golf style is accounted for. Choose the Casual clubs for a quick round with friends or the CPU, or increase the challenge with Regular and Pro club sets. Upgrade your clubs at the Equipment Counter and you'll be making hot shots golf players everywhere will be envious of!

Players can customise their characters with a range of designs, hair styles and balls to choose from, with more available in the Steam Workshop. Computer controlled players can be added to a game either to fill out a team roster, to practice against - or simply to pit against other CPU players while you watch and relax. CPU players feature adaptive skill, so as the player's level increases, so does the challenge!

As well as Career mode, solo features of Super Video Golf include Monthly Challenges which start at the beginning of each month, and a club league where personal progress is pitted against CPU players. The league consists of 24 round seasons, with awards given for top 3 placement and CPU players whose difficulty increases to match the player, season by season.

The clubhouse also hosts all the player's personal stats, such as time spent on each course, the player's score history and any awards received from completing monthly challenges and winning the club league. If you know how to find them there are a few arcade games too!

Every month a new set of leaderboards are created so players can compete around the world to win trophies for placing anywhere in the top 3 in Free Play. Player stats are tracked and broken down by year, month or week and can be viewed from within the clubhouse.

Steam Workshop support means that it is easy to find new customisation options such as new balls or head wear, avatars, voices, flags... and even upload your own creations to share.

Not only that but Super Video Golf supports a wide array of resolutions, from as low as 640 x 480, all the way up to the latest UHD ultra wide displays. Full controller support means that big picture mode is fully supported, ideal for couch co-op play. It's also great on Steam Deck, where your progress is tracked online and offline - meaning you can golf wherever you go!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel 5th gen i5 or AMD Athlon (2015 or newer)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nvidia 1070 GTX or AMD Radeon RX5600XT (requires OpenGL 4.1 or higher, min 4GB VRAM). Intel integrated graphics may work, but are not officially supported.
  • Storage: 1170 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any OpenAL compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel 7th gen i5 or higher or AMD Ryzen
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nvidia 2070 RTX or AMD Radeon RX5700XT. 8GB VRAM or higher. Intel integrated graphics may work, but are not officially supported.
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1170 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any OpenAL compatible sound card with surround sound speakers
